name: Vixen
summary: Vixen Media Group's flagship luxury imprint: sun-drenched villas, fashion-editorial lighting, top-tier casting, and reference-grade 4K cinematography.
ranking_rationale: Sets the visual ceiling for luxury adult production with cinema-grade lighting and elite casting; lower weekly scene volume than megastudios, but far higher hit rate.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; available standalone or via the Vixen Plus all-network pass. Check official checkout.

pros: Consistently books top industry talent and major debuts
Clean, ad-free member streaming and download portal
Can be bundled with Blacked, Tushy, and Deeper via Vixen Plus
cons: Slower release cadence than high-volume studio networks
Standalone price is steep compared to bundling Vixen Plus
Hyper-polished aesthetic can feel less raw than gonzo studios

facts.value: Launched 2016; flagship brand of Vixen Media Group
Paid subscription (standalone or Vixen Plus bundle)
Fashion-editorial 4K visuals and international luxury locations
